<title level="1" right="Class Feature 1">[Humble Strikes](/Classes.aspx?ID=65)</title>

<column gap="tiny">
**Source** [War of Immortals](/Sources.aspx?ID=232) pg. 28

**Class** Exemplar
</column>

---

Even the most unassuming weapons can accomplish great deeds. When you are wielding a simple weapon, increase the damage die size of that weapon by one step.
